assets.prompt: Image 1 is a photograph of a whiteboard year planner with twelve numbered boxes. Keep the photograph exactly as it is: the same framing, the same board and wooden frame, the year at the top, every box number from 1 to 12 in the same place and every small grid of day squares. Do not move, redraw, add or remove any number. Add only this: inside box 10 (the second box of the bottom row), one small, simple, colorful hand-drawn BIRTHDAY CAKE in marker (a pink cake with three lit candles), about a third of the box high, placed in the empty right part of the box so that it does not cover the number 10; and ONE freehand dark-blue pen loop around the whole of box 10, enclosing its number and the cake. No other box has a drawing or a loop. The cake drawing is a picture only: a plain pink shape with three candles and NOTHING written on it or beside it. There are no letters, labels or words anywhere on the board, in any language; the only writing is the year and the box numbers that are already there.
